whoItsFor: Developers who run AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex and want to cut the token cost of shell command output the agent reads. It works as a drop-in proxy for common dev commands.
useCases: Compressing git status, diff, and log output before an AI agent reads it
Showing only failures from test runners like cargo test, pytest, and jest
Condensing lint, build, and container output such as tsc, ruff, and docker ps
